text: A free Hellraiser demo just landed on Steam.
It's thirty-two gigs, and Pinhead is waiting.
You play Aidan, using the famous puzzle box to survive a deal with the Cenobites.
It's first-person action horror. Grimy halls, spiked bats, shotguns, and a lot of blood.
Best moment in the trailer: one brutal swing of a spiked bat in a filthy hallway.
The catch? This trailer is almost all cutscene. Barely twenty seconds is actual gameplay.
It's in eight languages, and the full game is out October eighth.
Think Resident Evil 7, with Condemned's melee.
Worth a dip, if your drive has room for hell.
